grants.name: Brutal Strike
grants.on: a Strength attack hit after giving up Reckless Attack’s Advantage on it

grants.name: Instinctive Pounce
grants.note: Move up to half your Speed as part of the Bonus Action that starts your Rage.

grants.name: Frenzy
grants.on: the first target you hit with a Strength attack on a Reckless Attack turn

grants.name: Intimidating Presence
grants.note: 30-ft Emanation: WIS save (DC 8 + STR + PB) or Frightened for 1 minute. Or expend a Rage use to restore it.

grants.name: Retaliation
grants.note: When a creature within 5 ft damages you, make one melee attack against it.

grants.name: Persistent Rage
grants.note: On rolling Initiative, regain all Rage uses. Rage lasts 10 minutes without extending.

grants.name: Rage
grants.note: Not in Heavy armor. Rage Damage bonus on Strength-based weapon and Unarmed Strike damage; Advantage on Strength checks; no spells or Concentration.

grants.name: Reckless Attack
grants.note: On your first attack roll of the turn: Advantage on Strength attacks until your next turn; attacks against you have Advantage.

grants.name: Relentless Rage
grants.note: At 0 HP while raging: DC 10 CON save (+5 per use until a rest) to have HP equal to twice your Barbarian level.

grants.name: Bardic Inspiration
grants.note: A creature within 60 ft gains a die to add to a failed D20 Test within the hour.

grants.name: Cutting Words
grants.note: Expend a Bardic Inspiration die and subtract it from a creature’s damage roll, ability check or attack roll within 60 ft.

grants.name: Peerless Skill
grants.note: On a failed ability check or attack roll, add a Bardic Inspiration die; it isn’t spent if you still fail.

grants.name: Countercharm
grants.note: When you or a creature within 30 ft fails a save against Charmed or Frightened, reroll with Advantage.

grants.name: Font of Inspiration
grants.note: Bardic Inspiration returns on a Short or Long Rest; expend a spell slot to regain one use.

grants.name: Superior Inspiration
grants.note: On rolling Initiative, regain Bardic Inspiration uses up to 2.

grants.name: Divine Spark
grants.note: Heal a creature within 30 ft the roll + WIS, or deal it as Necrotic or Radiant damage (CON save for half).

grants.name: Turn Undead
grants.note: Undead of your choice within 30 ft: WIS save or Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute.

grants.name: Divine Intervention
grants.note: Cast a Cleric spell of level 5 or lower without a slot or Material components.

grants.name: Disciple of Life
grants.note: A slot spell that restores HP restores 2 + the slot’s level more.

grants.name: Preserve Life
grants.note: Spend Channel Divinity: restore 5 × Cleric level HP among Bloodied creatures within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

grants.name: Sear Undead
grants.note: Turn Undead also deals Radiant damage to each Undead that fails: roll a number of d8s equal to your WIS modifier (min 1).

grants.name: Evergreen Wild Shape
grants.note: On rolling Initiative with no Wild Shape uses, regain one.

grants.name: Nature Magician
grants.note: Turn Wild Shape uses into one spell slot, 2 levels per use.

grants.name: Beast Spells
grants.note: Cast spells in Wild Shape, except those with a costly or consumed Material component.

grants.name: Land type (choose on each Long Rest)
Land’s Aid
grants.note: Spend a Wild Shape use: 10-ft Sphere within 60 ft, CON save or Necrotic damage (half on a success); one creature there regains the same roll in HP.

grants.name: Natural Recovery
grants.note: Cast a Circle spell without a slot, once per Long Rest; on a Short Rest, recover slots worth half your Druid level.

grants.name: Nature’s Sanctuary
grants.note: Spend a Wild Shape use: a 15-ft Cube within 120 ft for 1 minute gives you and allies Half Cover and your Nature’s Ward Resistance.

options.name: Primal Strike
options.on: a weapon or Beast form attack hit

grants.name: Improved Elemental Fury
grants.note: Potent Spellcasting: Druid cantrips with a range of 10 ft or more gain 300 ft. Primal Strike: 2d8.

grants.name: Wild Companion
grants.note: Expend a spell slot or a Wild Shape use: cast Find Familiar without Material components.

grants.name: Wild Resurgence
grants.note: Expend a Wild Shape use to gain a level 1 spell slot.

grants.name: Wild Shape
grants.note: Shape-shift into a known Beast form for hours equal to half your Druid level.

grants.name: Action Surge
grants.note: Take one more action on your turn (not Magic); once per turn.

grants.name: Heroic Warrior
grants.note: In combat, gain Heroic Inspiration at the start of your turn if you have none.

grants.name: Remarkable Athlete
grants.note: Advantage on Initiative and Athletics checks; after a Critical Hit, move half your Speed without provoking.

grants.name: Survivor
grants.note: Advantage on Death Saving Throws (18–20 counts as 20); while Bloodied, regain 5 + CON HP at the start of your turn.

grants.name: Indomitable
grants.note: Reroll a failed save with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

grants.name: Second Wind
grants.note: Regain the roll in HP.

grants.name: Studied Attacks
grants.note: After a miss, Advantage on your next attack against that creature.

grants.name: Tactical Master
grants.note: Replace a weapon’s mastery property with Push, Sap or Slow for an attack.

grants.name: Tactical Mind
grants.note: On a failed ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10 (kept if you still fail).

grants.name: Tactical Shift
grants.note: When you use Second Wind, move half your Speed without provoking.

grants.name: Deflect Attacks
grants.note: Reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing attack damage by 1d10 + DEX + Monk level; at 0, spend 1 Focus Point to redirect it.

grants.name: Disciplined Survivor
grants.note: Spend 1 Focus Point to reroll a failed save.

grants.name: Martial Arts: Monk weapons use DEX
Bonus Unarmed Strike
grants.note: Make an Unarmed Strike.

grants.name: Flurry of Blows
grants.note: Spend 1 Focus Point: two Unarmed Strikes (three from level 10).

grants.name: Patient Defense
grants.note: Disengage; or spend 1 Focus Point to Disengage and Dodge.

grants.name: Step of the Wind
grants.note: Dash; or spend 1 Focus Point to Disengage and Dash with a doubled jump.

grants.name: Slow Fall
grants.note: Reduce falling damage by 5 × Monk level.

grants.name: Stunning Strike
grants.note: Once per turn on a hit, spend 1 Focus Point: CON save or Stunned until your next turn.

grants.name: Superior Defense
grants.note: Spend 3 Focus Points at the start of your turn: Resistance to all damage but Force for 1 minute.

grants.name: Uncanny Metabolism
grants.note: On rolling Initiative, regain all Focus Points and HP equal to Monk level + a Martial Arts die.

grants.name: Fleet Step
grants.note: After another Bonus Action, also use Step of the Wind.

grants.name: Open Hand Technique
grants.note: A Flurry of Blows hit can Addle, Push 15 ft (STR save) or Topple (DEX save).

grants.name: Quivering Palm
grants.note: Spend 4 Focus Points on an Unarmed Strike hit; end it later for a CON save or 10d12 Force (half on a success).

grants.name: Wholeness of Body
grants.note: Regain a Martial Arts die + WIS in HP.

grants.name: Fighting Style feat or Druidic Warrior

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.on: a weapon hit on a creature missing Hit Points

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.note: Once per turn, attack another creature within 5 ft of the first target with the same weapon.
